fullPassage: Over the last few centuries, humanity’s collective prosperity has skyrocketed, as technological progress has made us far wealthier than ever before. To share out those riches, almost all societies have settled upon the market mechanism, rewarding people in various ways for the work that they do and the things that they own. But rising inequality, itself often driven by technology, has started to put that mechanism under strain. Today, markets already provide immense rewards to some people but leave many others with very little. And now, technological unemployment threatens to become a more radical version of the same story, taking place in the particular market we rely upon the most: the labor market. As that market begins to break down, more and more people will be in danger of _____________________________.

questions.passage: Over the last few centuries, humanity’s collective prosperity has skyrocketed, as technological progress has made us far wealthier than ever before. To share out those riches, almost all societies have ①<u>settled</u> upon the market mechanism, rewarding people in various ways for the work that they do and the things that they own. But rising inequality, itself often driven by technology, has started to put that mechanism under strain. Today, markets already ②<u>provide</u> immense rewards to some people but leave many others with very little. And now, technological unemployment ③<u>threatening</u> to become a more radical version of the same story, taking place in the particular market we rely upon the most: the labor market. As that market begins to ④<u>break</u> down, more and more people will be in danger of _____________________________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ threatening → threatens: 주어 unemployment의 본동사 자리라 threatens가 맞아요.
det.analysis:
❌ ① settled(정착했다) — 'have settled upon'에서 have 뒤 과거분사, 정상이에요.

❌ ② provide(제공하다) — 주어 markets가 복수라 provide, 정상이에요.

✅ ③ threatening → 원문은 threatens. 이 자리는 주어 'technological unemployment(기술적 실업)'의 진짜 동사(본동사) 자리예요. 문장에 본동사가 없으면 안 되므로 -ing형 threatening이 아니라 threatens를 써야 해요 ←정답

❌ ④ break(무너지다) — 'begins to break down'에서 to 뒤 동사원형, 정상이에요.
det.tip: 한 문장의 주어에는 본동사가 필요. threatens(O) / threatening(X, 준동사)

questions.passage: Over the last few centuries, humanity’s ①<u>collective</u> prosperity has skyrocketed, as technological progress has made us far wealthier than ever before. To share out those riches, almost all societies have settled upon the market mechanism, rewarding people in various ways for ②<u>the work what they do</u> and the things that they own. But rising inequality, itself often driven by technology, has started to put that mechanism under strain. Today, markets already provide immense rewards to some people but leave many others with very little. And now, technological unemployment threatens to become a more radical version of the same story, taking place in the particular market we ③<u>rely</u> upon the most: the labor market. As that market begins to ④<u>break</u> down, more and more people will be in danger of _____________________________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② what → that: 앞에 선행사 the work가 있으므로 관계대명사 that(또는 which)을 써야 해요.
det.analysis:
❌ ① collective(집단의) — 형용사, 정상이에요.

✅ ② the work what they do → 원문은 the work that they do. what은 선행사(꾸밈을 받는 명사)를 스스로 포함하는 관계대명사라 앞에 명사가 오면 안 돼요. 여기는 앞에 the work라는 명사가 있으니 that(또는 which)을 써야 해요 ←정답

❌ ③ rely(의존하다) — 주어 we라 rely, 정상이에요.

❌ ④ break(무너지다) — to 뒤 동사원형, 정상이에요.
det.tip: 선행사(명사) 뒤 → that/which. 선행사 없으면 → what

questions.passage: Over the last few centuries, humanity’s collective prosperity has skyrocketed, as technological progress has ①<u>made us to be far wealthier</u> than ever before. But rising inequality, itself often driven by technology, has started to put that mechanism under strain. Today, markets already ③<u>provide</u> immense rewards to some people but leave many others with very little. And now, technological unemployment threatens to become a more radical version of the same story, taking place in the particular market we ④<u>rely</u> upon the most: the labor market. As that market begins to break down, more and more people will be in danger of _____________________________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① made us to be far wealthier → made us far wealthier: 사역동사 make는 'make + 목적어 + 형용사' 형태로, to be를 넣지 않아요.
det.analysis:
✅ ① made us to be far wealthier → 원문은 made us far wealthier. make가 '~을 …하게 만들다'라는 뜻일 때는 'make + 목적어(us) + 형용사(wealthier)'로 바로 이어요. 사이에 to be를 넣으면 틀려요 ←정답

❌ ② settled(정착했다) — have 뒤 과거분사, 정상이에요.

❌ ③ provide(제공하다) — 주어 markets 복수, 정상이에요.

❌ ④ rely(의존하다) — 주어 we, 정상이에요.
det.tip: make + 목적어 + 형용사 (to be 없음). made us wealthier(O)

questions.passage: Over the last few centuries, humanity’s ①<u>collective</u> prosperity has skyrocketed, as technological progress has made us far wealthier than ever before. To share out those riches, almost all societies have ②<u>settled</u> upon the market mechanism, rewarding people in various ways for the work that they do and the things that they own. But rising inequality, itself often driven by technology, has started to put that mechanism under strain. Today, markets already ③<u>withhold</u> immense rewards to some people but leave many others with very little. And now, technological unemployment threatens to become a more radical version of the same story, taking place in the particular market we rely upon the most: the ④<u>labor</u> market. As that market begins to break down, more and more people will be in danger of _____________________________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ withhold(주지 않다) → 원문: provide(제공하다). 시장이 일부에게 보상을 '준다'는 문맥이라 반대예요.
det.analysis:
❌ ① collective(집단의) 문맥 적합.

❌ ② settled(정착했다) 문맥 적합.

✅ ③ withhold(주지 않다, 보류하다) → 원문은 provide(제공하다). 시장이 일부 사람에게 막대한 보상을 '제공한다'는 내용이라, 주지 않는다는 뜻의 withhold는 반대라 부적절해요 ←정답

❌ ④ labor(노동) — the labor market, 문맥 적합.
det.tip: provide(제공하다) ↔ withhold(주지 않다)

questions.passage: Over the last few centuries, humanity’s collective prosperity has skyrocketed, as ①<u>technological</u> progress has made us far wealthier than ever before. To share out those riches, almost all societies have ②<u>settled</u> upon the market mechanism, rewarding people in various ways for the work that they do and the things that they own. But rising inequality, itself often driven by technology, has started to put that mechanism under strain. Today, markets already ③<u>provide</u> immense rewards to some people but leave many others with very little. And now, technological unemployment threatens to become a more radical version of the same story, taking place in the particular market we rely upon ④<u>the least</u>: the labor market. As that market begins to break down, more and more people will be in danger of _____________________________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ the least(가장 적게) → 원문: the most(가장 많이). 우리가 가장 많이 '의존하는' 시장이라는 문맥이라 반대예요.
det.analysis:
❌ ① technological(기술의) 문맥 적합.

❌ ② settled(정착했다) 문맥 적합.

❌ ③ provide(제공하다) 문맥 적합.

✅ ④ the least(가장 적게) → 원문은 the most(가장 많이). 노동 시장은 우리가 '가장 많이' 의존하는 시장이라고 콜론 뒤에서 강조하는 문맥이라, 가장 적게라는 뜻의 the least는 반대라 부적절해요 ←정답
det.tip: rely upon the most(가장 많이 의존) ↔ the least(가장 적게)

questions.passage: Over the last few centuries, humanity’s collective prosperity has skyrocketed, as technological progress has made us far wealthier than ever before. To share out those riches, almost all societies have settled upon the market mechanism, rewarding people in various ways for the work that they do and the things that they own. But rising inequality, itself often driven by technology, has started to put that mechanism under strain. Today, markets already provide immense rewards to some people but leave many others with very little. And now, technological unemployment threatens to become a more radical version of the same story, taking place in the particular market we rely upon the most: the labor market. As that market begins to __________, more and more people will be in danger of _____________________________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸 뒤에 '사람들이 위험에 처한다'가 이어지므로, 시장이 '무너진다(break down)'가 맞아요.
det.analysis:
빈칸은 'As that market begins to ____, more and more people will be in danger(그 시장이 ____하기 시작하면 점점 더 많은 사람이 위험에 처한다)'예요. 사람들이 위험에 빠지는 원인은 시장이 '무너지는' 것이에요.

✅ ① break down(무너지다, 붕괴하다) ←정답
❌ ② speed up(속도를 높이다) — 붕괴 문맥과 안 맞아요.
❌ ③ open up(열리다) — 부적합해요.
❌ ④ carry on(계속하다) — 위험과 연결되지 않아요.
det.tip: break down = 무너지다, 붕괴하다

questions.passage: Over the last few centuries, humanity’s collective prosperity has skyrocketed, as technological progress has made us far wealthier than ever before. To share out those riches, almost all societies have settled upon the market mechanism, rewarding people __________ for the work that they do and the things that they own. But rising inequality, itself often driven by technology, has started to put that mechanism under strain. Today, markets already provide immense rewards to some people but leave many others with very little. And now, technological unemployment threatens to become a more radical version of the same story, taking place in the particular market we rely upon the most: the labor market. As that market begins to break down, more and more people will be in danger of _____________________________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 사람마다 하는 일과 소유가 다르므로 '다양한 방식으로(in various ways)' 보상한다는 문맥이에요.
det.analysis:
빈칸은 'rewarding people ____ for the work that they do and the things that they own(사람들이 하는 일과 소유한 것에 따라 ____ 보상하면서)'이에요. 일과 소유가 사람마다 다르니 보상 방식도 여러 가지예요.

✅ ② in various ways(다양한 방식으로) ←정답
❌ ① in equal shares(균등한 몫으로) — 뒤의 불평등 내용과 안 맞아요.
❌ ③ in secret places(은밀한 장소에서) — 문맥과 무관해요.
❌ ④ at fixed rates(고정된 비율로) — '다양함'과 반대예요.
det.tip: in various ways = 다양한 방식으로

questions.passage: Over the last few centuries, humanity’s collective prosperity has skyrocketed, as technological progress has made us far wealthier than ever before. To share out those riches, almost all societies have settled upon the market mechanism, rewarding people in various ways for the work that they do and the things that they own. But rising inequality, itself often driven by technology, has started to put that mechanism under strain. Today, markets already provide immense rewards to some people but leave many others with very little. And now, technological unemployment threatens to become a more radical version of the same story, taking place in the particular market we rely upon the most: the labor market. As that market begins to break down, more and more people will be in danger of _____________________________.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ① 일치 — 'technological progress has made us far wealthier than ever before'.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 기술 발전이 지난 수 세기 동안 인류를 더 부유하게 만들었다 — 본문과 일치해요 ←정답

❌ ② 'almost all societies(거의 모든 사회)'가 채택했으므로 '소수만'은 틀려요.

❌ ③ 일부는 막대한 보상을, 다수는 아주 적게 받으므로 '균등'이 아니에요.

❌ ④ 기술적 실업은 바로 노동 시장에서 일어나요.
det.tip: made us far wealthier = 더 부유하게 만들었다

ch: 기술 발전은 지난 수 세기 동안 인류를 더 부유하게 만들었다.
시장 방식은 소수의 사회에서만 예외적으로 채택되었다.
오늘날 시장은 모든 사람에게 균등하게 보상한다.
기술적 실업은 노동 시장과 무관한 곳에서 발생한다.

questions.passage: Over the last few centuries, humanity’s collective prosperity has skyrocketed, as technological progress has made us far wealthier than ever before. To share out those riches, almost all societies have settled upon the market mechanism, rewarding people in various ways for the work that they do and the things that they own. But rising inequality, itself often driven by technology, has started to put that mechanism under strain. Today, markets already provide immense rewards to some people but leave many others with very little. And now, technological unemployment threatens to become a more radical version of the same story, taking place in the particular market we rely upon the most: the labor market. As that market begins to break down, more and more people will be in danger of _____________________________.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ③ 불일치 — 시장 방식은 '무너지기(break down)' 시작한다고 했지 견고해진다고 하지 않았어요.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 일치 — 'inequality ... driven by technology(기술에 의해 촉발되는 불평등)'.

❌ ② 일치 — 'for the work that they do and the things that they own(일과 소유에 따라 보상)'.

✅ ③ 불일치 — 본문은 그 시장(방식)이 부담을 받고 결국 '무너지기 시작한다'고 했어요. '더 견고하게 만든다'는 정반대라 일치하지 않아요 ←정답

❌ ④ 일치 — 'the particular market we rely upon the most(가장 많이 의존하는 시장)'.
det.tip: break down(무너지다) ≠ 견고

ch: 불평등의 증가는 부분적으로 기술에 의해 촉발된다.
시장은 사람들의 노동과 소유에 따라 보상을 나눈다.
기술적 실업은 시장 방식을 오히려 더 견고하게 만든다.
노동 시장은 우리가 가장 크게 의존하는 시장이다.

questions.passage: Over the last few centuries, humanity’s collective prosperity has skyrocketed, as technological progress has made us far wealthier than ever before. To share out those riches, almost all societies have settled upon the market mechanism, rewarding people in various ways for the work that they do and the things that they own. But rising inequality, itself often driven by technology, has started to put that mechanism under strain. Today, markets already provide immense rewards to some people but leave many others with very little. And now, technological unemployment threatens to become a more radical version of the same story, taking place in the particular market we rely upon the most: the labor market. As that market begins to break down, more and more people will be in danger of _____________________________.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ④ 불일치 — 'a more radical version(더 급진적인 형태)'이라 했지 '온건한'이 아니에요.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 일치 — 'prosperity has skyrocketed(번영이 치솟았다)'.

❌ ② 일치 — 'immense rewards to some ... very little(일부엔 큰 보상, 다수엔 적음)'.

❌ ③ 일치 — 'put that mechanism under strain(시장 방식에 부담)'.

✅ ④ 불일치 — 본문은 기술적 실업이 같은 이야기의 '더 급진적인(more radical)' 형태가 된다고 했어요. '더 온건한'은 정반대라 일치하지 않아요 ←정답
det.tip: a more radical version ≠ 온건한

ch: 지난 수 세기 동안 인류의 번영은 크게 치솟았다.
현재 시장은 일부에게 큰 보상을, 다수에게는 적은 몫을 준다.
불평등의 증가는 시장 방식에 부담을 주기 시작했다.
기술적 실업은 같은 문제의 더 온건한 형태이다.

questions.passage: Over the last few centuries, humanity’s collective prosperity has skyrocketed, as technological progress has made us far wealthier than ever before. To share out those riches, almost all societies have settled upon the market mechanism, rewarding people in various ways for the work that they do and the things that they own. But rising inequality, itself often driven by technology, has started to put that mechanism under strain. Today, markets already provide immense rewards to some people but leave many others with very little. And now, technological unemployment threatens to become a more radical version of the same story, taking place in the particular market we rely upon the most: the labor market. As that market begins to break down, more and more people will be in danger of _____________________________.
questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① 기술 발전 → 불평등 → 시장 부담 → 노동 시장 붕괴 위기.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 기술이 불평등을 키우고, 그 불평등이 시장 방식에 부담을 주며, 결국 노동 시장까지 무너뜨릴 위험을 말하는 글 전체 흐름과 맞아요 ←정답

❌ ② '번영의 역사'는 도입부일 뿐, 글의 핵심은 위기예요.

❌ ③ 새 직업이 아니라 '기술적 실업'을 다뤄요.

❌ ④ 조세·정부 정책은 언급되지 않았어요.
det.tip: technological unemployment → labor market breakdown

ch: 기술 발전이 키운 불평등과 노동 시장의 붕괴 위기
자유 시장 경제가 이룩한 인류 번영의 역사
기술 혁신이 창출하는 미래의 새로운 직업들
소득 재분배를 위한 조세 정책의 필요성

As that market begins to break down, more and more people will be in danger of _____________________________.
questions.stem: 위 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② 기술의 부정적 이면 + 위협받는 노동 시장.
det.analysis:
✅ ② '기술이 드리운 그늘'은 기술이 불평등·실업을 키운다는 부정적 측면을, '흔들리는 노동 시장'은 노동 시장 붕괴 위기를 압축해 담아 제목으로 맞아요 ←정답

❌ ① 본문은 '공정한 분배'가 아니라 불평등을 말해요.

❌ ③ 풍요는 도입부일 뿐, 핵심은 위기예요.

❌ ④ 정부의 해법은 언급되지 않았어요.
det.tip: dark side of technology + shaking labor market

ch: 시장 경제의 승리: 모두를 위한 공정한 분배
기술이 드리운 그늘: 흔들리는 노동 시장
풍요의 시대: 기술이 선사한 무한한 부

questions.passage: Over the last few centuries, humanity’s collective prosperity has skyrocketed, as technological progress has made us far wealthier than ever before. To share out those riches, almost all societies have settled upon the market mechanism, rewarding people in various ways for the work that they do and the things that they own. But rising inequality, itself often driven by technology, has started to put that mechanism under strain. Today, markets already provide immense rewards to some people but leave many others with very little. And now, technological unemployment threatens to become <u>a more radical version of the same story</u>, taking place in the particular market we rely upon the most: the labor market. As that market begins to break down, more and more people will be in danger of _____________________________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 a more radical version of the same story가 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: '같은 이야기(the same story)'는 앞에서 말한 불균등한 보상 분배를, '더 급진적인 형태'는 그것이 더 심해짐을 뜻해요.
det.analysis:
밑줄 앞 내용은 '시장이 일부에게는 막대한 보상을, 다수에게는 아주 적게 준다'는 불균등 분배예요. 'the same story(같은 이야기)'는 바로 그 불균등을 가리키고, 'a more radical version(더 급진적인 형태)'은 그 문제가 더 극단적으로 심해진다는 뜻이에요.

❌ ① 불평등이 사라지는 것이 아니라 심해져요.

❌ ② 새로운 시장 창조가 아니라 '같은' 문제의 악화예요.

✅ ③ 불균등 분배가 더 극단적으로 나타남 ←정답

❌ ④ '일시적·사소한'이 아니라 더 급진적(심각)이에요.
det.tip: same story(불균등 분배) + more radical(더 극단적) = 문제 악화

ch: 불평등이 완전히 사라진 새로운 경제를 뜻한다.
기술이 전혀 새로운 형태의 시장을 창조함을 뜻한다.
보상이 불균등하게 분배되는 현상이 더 극단적으로 나타남을 뜻한다.
노동 시장의 일시적이고 사소한 혼란을 뜻한다.

questions.passage: Over the last few centuries, humanity’s collective prosperity has skyrocketed, as technological progress has made us far wealthier than ever before. To share out <u>those riches</u>, almost all societies have settled upon the market mechanism, rewarding people in various ways for the work that they do and the things that they own. But rising inequality, itself often driven by technology, has started to put that mechanism under strain. Today, markets already provide immense rewards to some people but leave many others with very little. And now, technological unemployment threatens to become a more radical version of the same story, taking place in the particular market we rely upon the most: the labor market. As that market begins to break down, more and more people will be in danger of _____________________________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 those riches가 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: those riches = 앞 문장의 '치솟은 집단적 번영', 곧 기술 발전으로 늘어난 부.
det.analysis:
밑줄 앞 문장에서 '기술 발전 덕분에 인류의 집단적 번영이 치솟아 우리가 훨씬 부유해졌다'고 했어요. 'those riches(그 부)'는 바로 그 늘어난 번영·부를 가리켜요.

✅ ① 기술 발전으로 급등한 번영(늘어난 부) ←정답

❌ ② 임금은 세부 사례일 뿐, those riches가 가리키는 대상이 아니에요.

❌ ③ 효율성은 언급되지 않았어요.

❌ ④ 소수의 이익이 아니라 인류 전체의 번영이에요.
det.tip: those riches = collective prosperity(늘어난 부)

ch: 기술 발전으로 급등한 인류의 번영, 즉 늘어난 부

questions.passage: Over the last few centuries, humanity’s __________ has skyrocketed, as technological progress has made us far wealthier than ever before. To share out those riches, almost all societies have settled upon the market mechanism, rewarding people in various ways for the work that they do and the things that they own. But rising inequality, itself often driven by technology, has started to put that mechanism under strain. Today, markets already provide immense rewards to some people but leave many others with very little. And now, technological unemployment threatens to become a more radical version of the same story, taking place in the particular market we rely upon the most: the labor market. As that market begins to break down, more and more people will be in danger of _____________________________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 기술 발전으로 우리가 더 부유해졌다는 흐름이라, 치솟은 것은 인류의 '집단적 번영(collective prosperity)'이에요.
det.analysis:
빈칸은 'humanity's ____ has skyrocketed, as technological progress has made us far wealthier(기술 발전이 우리를 더 부유하게 만들면서 인류의 ____가 치솟았다)'예요. 뒤에 '더 부유해졌다'가 나오므로 치솟은 것은 인류 전체의 번영이에요.

❌ ① personal ambition(개인의 야망) — '인류 전체'와 안 맞아요.
❌ ② political power(정치 권력) — 부유함 문맥과 무관해요.
❌ ③ scientific theory(과학 이론) — 문맥과 무관해요.
✅ ④ collective prosperity(집단적 번영) ←정답
det.tip: collective prosperity = (인류의) 집단적 번영

questions.passage: Over the last few centuries, humanity’s collective prosperity has skyrocketed, as technological progress has made us far wealthier than ever before. To share out those riches, almost all societies have settled upon the market mechanism, rewarding people in various ways for the work that they do and the things that they own. But rising inequality, itself often driven by technology, has started to put that mechanism under strain. Today, markets already __________ but leave many others with very little. And now, technological unemployment threatens to become a more radical version of the same story, taking place in the particular market we rely upon the most: the labor market. As that market begins to break down, more and more people will be in danger of _____________________________.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 영어로 쓰시오.
"일부 사람들에게 막대한 보상을 제공하다"
[조건] (1) immense, people, provide, rewards, some, to 를 모두 사용할 것
(2) 6단어로 쓸 것
(영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 일부 사람들에게 막대한 보상을 제공하다.
det.analysis:
'제공하다'가 핵심 동사라 provide로 시작해요.

→ 무엇을? '막대한 보상' = immense rewards (형용사 immense + 명사 rewards).

→ 누구에게? '일부 사람들에게' = to some people (to + some + people).

→ 완성: provide immense rewards to some people.
det.tip: provide + 목적어(immense rewards) + to + 대상(some people)

questions.wa: provide immense rewards to some people
accept: provide immense rewards to some people

questions.passage: Over the last few centuries, humanity’s collective prosperity has skyrocketed, as technological progress has made us far wealthier than ever before. To share out those riches, almost all societies have settled upon the market mechanism, rewarding people in various ways for the work that they do and the things that they own. But rising inequality, itself often driven by technology, has started to put that mechanism under strain. Today, markets already provide immense rewards to some people but ①<u>leaving</u> many others with very little. And now, technological unemployment threatens to become a more radical version of the same story, taking place in the particular market we rely upon the most: the labor market. As that market begins to break down, more and more people will be in danger of _____________________________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①은 어법상 틀렸다. 어법에 맞게 올바른 형태로 고쳐 (한 단어, 영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: ① leaving → leave: 앞의 provide와 but으로 연결된 병렬 구조라, 같은 형태(동사원형)인 leave가 맞아요.
det.analysis:
밑줄이 있는 문장은 'markets already provide immense rewards to some people but ___ many others with very little(시장은 일부에게는 막대한 보상을 주지만, 다른 많은 이들에게는 아주 적게 ___한다)'예요.

① 여기서 but은 앞의 동사 provide와 뒤의 동사를 대등하게(병렬로) 이어 줘요. 주어가 markets(복수)이고 앞이 provide(동사원형 형태)이므로, 뒤도 같은 형태인 leave여야 해요.

② -ing형 leaving은 주어의 동사가 될 수 없어 틀려요. 그래서 leaving을 leave로 고쳐야 해요. 정답은 leave예요.
det.tip: A but B 병렬: provide ... but leave (같은 형태로 맞춤)

questions.passage: Over the last few centuries, humanity’s collective prosperity has skyrocketed, as technological progress has made us far wealthier than ever before. To share out those riches, almost all societies have settled upon the market mechanism, rewarding people in various ways for the work that they do and the things that they own. But rising inequality, itself often driven by technology, has started to put that mechanism under strain. Today, markets already provide immense rewards to some people but leave many others with very little. And now, technological unemployment threatens to become a more radical version of the same story, taking place in __________: the labor market. As that market begins to break down, more and more people will be in danger of _____________________________.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 영어로 쓰시오.
"우리가 가장 많이 의존하는 특정 시장"
[조건] (1) market, most, particular, rely, the(2회), upon, we 를 모두 사용할 것
(2) 8단어로 쓸 것
(영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 우리가 가장 많이 의존하는 특정 시장.
det.analysis:
'특정 시장'이 중심 명사예요 → the particular market.

→ 이 명사를 꾸미는 '우리가 가장 많이 의존하는'은 관계절로 뒤에 붙여요: we rely upon the most (우리가 the most 가장 많이 rely upon 의존하는).

→ 완성: the particular market we rely upon the most (관계대명사 that/which는 생략됨).
det.tip: the particular market + [we rely upon the most] (목적격 관계절, 관계사 생략)

questions.wa: the particular market we rely upon the most
accept: the particular market we rely upon the most

questions.passage: Over the last few centuries, humanity’s collective prosperity has skyrocketed, as technological progress has made us far wealthier than ever before. To share out those riches, __________, rewarding people in various ways for the work that they do and the things that they own. But rising inequality, itself often driven by technology, has started to put that mechanism under strain. Today, markets already provide immense rewards to some people but leave many others with very little. And now, technological unemployment threatens to become a more radical version of the same story, taking place in the particular market we rely upon the most: the labor market. As that market begins to break down, more and more people will be in danger of _____________________________.
questions.stem:
다음 주어진 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하시오. (영어로)

[ all / almost / have / market / mechanism / settled / societies / the / upon ] (9단어)

det.korean: 거의 모든 사회가 시장 방식에 정착했다.
det.analysis:
주어는 'almost all societies(거의 모든 사회)'예요. (almost + all + societies 순서)

→ 동사는 현재완료 'have settled(정착해 왔다)'이고, 뒤에 전치사 upon을 붙여요.

→ 무엇에? the market mechanism(그 시장 방식).

→ 완성: almost all societies have settled upon the market mechanism.
det.tip: almost all societies = 주어 / have settled upon ~ = ~에 정착했다

questions.wa: almost all societies have settled upon the market mechanism
accept: almost all societies have settled upon the market mechanism

questions.passage: Over the last few centuries, humanity’s collective prosperity has skyrocketed, as technological progress has made us far wealthier than ever before. To share out those riches, almost all societies have settled upon the market mechanism, rewarding people in various ways for the work that they do and the things that they own. But rising inequality, itself often driven by technology, __________. Today, markets already provide immense rewards to some people but leave many others with very little. And now, technological unemployment threatens to become a more radical version of the same story, taking place in the particular market we rely upon the most: the labor market. As that market begins to break down, more and more people will be in danger of _____________________________.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 영어로 쓰시오.
"그 방식에 부담을 주기 시작했다"
[조건] (1) has, mechanism, put, started, strain, that, to, under 를 모두 사용할 것
(2) 8단어로 쓸 것
(영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 그 방식에 부담을 주기 시작했다.
det.analysis:
'~하기 시작했다'가 뼈대예요 → has started to + 동사원형.

→ 무엇을 하기 시작? '부담을 주다' = put A under strain (A를 부담 아래 두다). 여기서 A는 that mechanism(그 방식)이에요.

→ 순서: put + that mechanism + under + strain.

→ 완성: has started to put that mechanism under strain.
det.tip: has started to put + [that mechanism] + under strain (~에 부담을 주기 시작했다)

questions.wa: has started to put that mechanism under strain
accept: has started to put that mechanism under strain
